title: MDCheck: Automated Convergence, Statistical Inefficiency, and Reproducibility Assessment for Molecular Dynamics Simulations
description: An open-source scientific toolkit for rigorous quality assurance, automated equilibration detection (t_eq), integrated autocorrelation time (tau_int), effective sample size (N_eff), multi-replica convergence, and manuscript-ready reporting for molecular dynamics simulations.
